versions.changelog: Add evidence-backed openings, judge-gated 20-40 rounds, and universal lesson quality gate

Initial release of debate-learning-workflow skill.

- Enables multi-agent debates (A, B, Opponent3, Judge) with 20–40 structured rounds.
- Incorporates loophole analysis and lesson extraction in every debate.
- Requires evidence and sources for all claims.
- Generates debate records, daily index files, and updates a centralized lesson log.
- Implements judge moderation for critical loopholes and round continuation.
